author: comms@lumivia.be
title: Lumivia Weekly #112
body:
Lumivia Weekly - issue #112

- Welcome to our new colleagues in sales!
- The Q2 all-hands recording is on the intranet.
- Reminder: keep your laptop updated, IT will push an update next week.
- Congratulations to the data team for shipping the new dashboard.
- Don't forget to register for the summer BBQ.
- Tip of the week: book meeting rooms in the calendar, not on the door.
